description: Failure-mode register: the 20 given scenarios (FM-001 to FM-020) and the discovered ones (FM-021 on). Verdicts from the investigation of 2026-10-21/22; tests carry their ID in the test name. Severity: P0 data loss or guest harm now, P1 safety or booking integrity at risk, P2 wrong answers or broken flows, P3 limited impact. Results are written by npm run eval:failure-modes.

releaseGate.rule: Blocked while any P0/P1 entry in these categories has a failing test, no test, or a fix status other than fixed or no change needed.

journeys.title: First-time customer: what's good, the menu, hours, then a table
journeys.adaptation: Adapted: no accounts, so 'first-time' is a fresh session.

journeys.title: Budget meal: ₹1,000 for two, then a changed budget
e2e: a meal for two within a budget

journeys.title: Dietary: vegetarian, a nut allergy, then a change
Timings: a branch switch, a special date, 'tonight'
Reservation failure: slot taken, database error, rate limit
e2e: Start over on a locked card

journeys.title: Model failure: down, slow, malformed
e2e: a failed chat request says so

journeys.title: Malicious input: injection, crafted context, hostile documents
Concurrent operations: last table, retries, double taps
e2e: one guest action sends one chat request

failureModes.title: Unsupported bestseller or popularity claims
failureModes.trigger: Popularity worded as 'most-ordered', 'known for', 'can't stop ordering', 'trending', or 'chef's special' / 'what are you famous for?'.
failureModes.expected: No dish is called popular without the staff bestseller mark; signature or speciality questions get an honest answer.
failureModes.actual: Those phrasings passed the claim check (HYPE_RE), and signature questions went to the chooser, which presented a dish as the answer.
failureModes.rootCause: The claim patterns covered only a few words, and the evidence classifier had no signature/speciality reading.
failureModes.resolution: Wider claim patterns with honest-statement exceptions (lib/chat/claims.ts); signature questions answered from data (lib/chat/evidence.ts).

failureModes.title: A changed dietary preference keeps controlling recommendations
failureModes.trigger: 'Forget the gluten-free', 'I'm not coeliac', 'Forget Jain', 'I'm vegetarian now' (from vegan); a model that copies an old budget into a new request.
failureModes.expected: The latest stated preference wins; a budget needs a price in the guest's words.
failureModes.actual: Gluten-free and Jain were re-read from the negation; the model's copied maxPrice narrowed a new request.
failureModes.rootCause: Diet readers ignored negation, and the model's maxPrice was trusted without the guest saying a price.
failureModes.resolution: Negation guards and lifts in lib/chat/recommend.ts; the model's maxPrice is used only when a price is in the message.

failureModes.title: 'Something light' produces an assumed menu section
failureModes.trigger: 'I want something light.' The model guesses a section (desserts).
failureModes.expected: Ask which kind of dish (snack, main, dessert) before choosing, and trace any section only the model read.
failureModes.actual: The model's guessed course was used, and a chooser call picked from that section.
failureModes.rootCause: The model's course was taken as stated.
failureModes.resolution: Only a stated course narrows; a model-only course is used for that request only and traced as inferred; the meal-type question is asked.

failureModes.title: 'Make it cheaper' and 'the second one' lose their reference
failureModes.trigger: A follow-up after a question about one dish, or 'the second one' after a list.
failureModes.expected: Comparisons anchor to the dish last shown; the prompt numbers the dishes shown, in order.
failureModes.actual: 'Cheaper' compared with an older suggestion; the prompt listed suggested dishes unnumbered.
failureModes.rootCause: The context kept only recommended IDs, not what was last shown.
failureModes.resolution: context.shown records what each reply showed; the prompt (v9) numbers it; the anchor for cheaper/another uses it.

failureModes.title: Prompt injection overrides instructions or exposes internals
failureModes.trigger: Guest text asking the bot to reveal its rules or to state a fact the data lacks.
failureModes.expected: No instructions or prompt text reach the guest; facts come only from the data.
failureModes.actual: A smalltalk reply could paraphrase its own rules ('my rules say...'); the guards blocked fabricated numbers, prices and dishes.
failureModes.rootCause: The smalltalk filter did not look for talk about instructions.
failureModes.resolution: smalltalkShowable refuses replies about instructions, prompts or rules. Live injection cases (LV-INJ-*) still pass.
failureModes.remainingRisk: A non-numeric fabricated fact in a free-text FAQ answer is caught only if it contradicts a known claim pattern; the live evals measure it.

failureModes.title: An unavailable dish is still offered
failureModes.trigger: An answer naming an unavailable dish by its short name ('the pomfret'), or citing it without saying it is unavailable.
failureModes.expected: Unavailable dishes are never offered as available.
failureModes.actual: The unavailable check matched only full names in the same sentence.
failureModes.rootCause: Name matching used full names only.
failureModes.resolution: claimProblems checks partial names per sentence and any cited unavailable dish.

failureModes.title: Wrong branch or special-date hours in an answer
failureModes.trigger: A mixed question on a special date ('open for dinner on 22 October, and is there parking?').
failureModes.expected: The day's exception (closed for a private event) is used, from the hours card.
failureModes.actual: The FAQ path accepted the weekly dinner hours for a date with an exception.
failureModes.rootCause: Grounding didn't check hours against the asked date.
failureModes.resolution: Hours sentences are grounded against the date's hours and exceptions; a failure falls back to the hours card.

failureModes.title: An outdated document or FAQ overrides the menu
failureModes.trigger: A document or answer giving a dish an old price.
failureModes.expected: The menu table is authoritative for prices.
failureModes.actual: A price next to a dish's name wasn't compared with the menu.
failureModes.rootCause: No price check per dish.
failureModes.resolution: claimProblems refuses a dish named with a price that isn't its menu price.
failureModes.remainingRisk: Non-price conflicts between a staff document and the FAQs (policy wording) are not detected; staff see content warnings only for times and booking words.

failureModes.impact: A guest with an allergy or diet could order a dish the menu labels contradict.
failureModes.title: Unsupported dietary or allergen claims
failureModes.trigger: Claims worded 'non-dairy', 'eggless', 'wheat-free', 'no animal products', or 'as is the kulfi'.
failureModes.expected: Every diet claim matches the dish's labels.
failureModes.actual: Those wordings weren't read as diet claims.
failureModes.rootCause: DIET_WORDS covered only the main labels.
failureModes.resolution: More diet wordings and echoed subjects are checked (lib/chat/recommend.ts).

failureModes.title: Two requests book the last table at once
failureModes.trigger: 20 processes book the one fitting table at the same instant.
failureModes.expected: Exactly one booking; the others get SLOT_TAKEN.
failureModes.actual: Held: 1 booking, 19 SLOT_TAKEN, in 10 runs (and the triggers alone hold it).
failureModes.rootCause: IMMEDIATE transactions plus overlap triggers.
failureModes.resolution: No change. Existing race test tagged FM-010.

failureModes.title: A booking is confirmed although the write failed
failureModes.trigger: SQLITE_FULL, a failing trigger, or a thrown error during the insert.
failureModes.expected: No confirmation without a saved row.
failureModes.actual: No false confirmation found; the client builds the card only from a 201/200 body.
failureModes.rootCause: By design (BR-12).
failureModes.resolution: No change needed for the invariant; FM-037 made the message say 'nothing was booked' when the write was rolled back.

failureModes.title: Retries create duplicate bookings
failureModes.trigger: 20 processes retry with one idempotency key, or one guest double-taps with new keys.
failureModes.expected: One booking: replays get 200 with the same row; new keys get DUPLICATE_BOOKING.
failureModes.actual: Held in every run.
failureModes.rootCause: Idempotency key with request hash, and a per-branch guest-overlap check and trigger.
failureModes.resolution: No change. New 20-process races for both cases (tests/integration/race.test.ts).

failureModes.title: Relative dates or times resolve incorrectly
failureModes.trigger: 'Tomorrow at 7:30 pm' read by the model as 19:00 on the day after tomorrow.
failureModes.expected: Code's reading of one unambiguous clock time and of today/tonight/tomorrow wins.
failureModes.actual: The model's time was kept if its 12-hour hour appeared anywhere; relative days were left to the model.
failureModes.rootCause: statedClockTime only filled a missing time; no relative-day reader.
failureModes.resolution: guardExtraction corrects the time from the text and reads today/tonight/tomorrow/the day after tomorrow when no other date words are present.

failureModes.title: A mid-flow change leaves a stale time
failureModes.trigger: 'Lunch is better after all' with 8 PM held, or 'make it an hour later'.
failureModes.expected: The old time is dropped and the guest picks a new one.
failureModes.actual: The same 8 PM confirm card came back.
failureModes.rootCause: The time was cleared only when the stored meal differed; relative changes were dropped.
failureModes.resolution: A meal that contradicts the held time, or a relative change with no clock time, clears the time.

failureModes.title: Ollama slow or stuck: the guest waits with no way out
failureModes.trigger: A guest turn queued behind a slow warm-up step, or a request that never answers.
failureModes.expected: Bounded waits; Try again after a timeout.
failureModes.actual: The queue had no deadline and the client fetch had no timeout; 'Still working on it' could stay for minutes with controls disabled.
failureModes.rootCause: Per-call timeouts only, set after the queue.
failureModes.resolution: The model gate refuses a call after 30 s in the queue (busy reply); the client gives up after 90 s with Try again (a retry joins the running turn).
failureModes.baselineEvidence: The E2E spec failed against the chat panel of c99e3e7 (git show c99e3e7:components/chat/ChatPanel.tsx, rebuilt; 2026-10-22), and passes with the fix.

failureModes.title: An old chat turn's Try again brings back a stale card
failureModes.trigger: A lost chat response, then a refused booking, then Try again.
failureModes.expected: A reply newer than the failed turn clears its Try again.
failureModes.actual: Try again replayed the cached older reply, whose confirm card was for a slot just taken.
failureModes.rootCause: The retry state survived a refused booking.
failureModes.resolution: A booking outcome that adds a reply clears the failed turn and chatPending.
failureModes.baselineEvidence: The E2E spec failed against the chat panel of c99e3e7 (rebuilt; 2026-10-22), and passes with the fix.

failureModes.title: Long text overflows the phone layout
failureModes.trigger: A pasted 250-character link at 360 px.
failureModes.expected: Text wraps; nothing scrolls sideways.
failureModes.actual: The conversation scroller widened; the E2E check measured only the document, which the clipped frame hides.
failureModes.rootCause: No overflow-wrap in the chat; the check measured the wrong element.
failureModes.resolution: wrap-anywhere on the conversation; the E2E overflow check measures the conversation scroller.
failureModes.baselineEvidence: The E2E spec failed with the fix removed (rebuilt; 2026-10-22) and against the chat panel of c99e3e7, and passes with the fix.

failureModes.title: Unauthorized admin operations
failureModes.trigger: A browser on another site or port, DNS rebinding, a LAN client, or an opaque origin.
failureModes.expected: Staff routes are reachable only from this computer.
failureModes.actual: All refused (403); the server binds to 127.0.0.1. There is no sign-in, by decision D-22.
failureModes.rootCause: D-22: no staff password; loopback and same-origin rules only.
failureModes.resolution: No change; regression tests for the rules and the loopback bind.
failureModes.remainingRisk: Anyone using this computer can read and change bookings (accepted in D-22). A start command without -H 127.0.0.1 would expose the routes.

failureModes.title: A guest sees another guest's details
failureModes.trigger: A booking with the same mobile and a different name; any booking response.
failureModes.expected: Responses never echo phone or email; a stranger learns no reference, time or name.
failureModes.actual: Held; the generic 409 confirms only that a booking exists around that time (J7, by design).
failureModes.rootCause: By design (D-14 J7).
failureModes.resolution: No change; a regression test, and the code comment no longer overstates what a stranger learns.
failureModes.remainingRisk: Knowledge documents can hold personal contact details (FM-051, warned).

failureModes.title: An admin update is saved but not reflected for guests
failureModes.trigger: An embedding-model outage while staff edit; a restart during a refresh.
failureModes.expected: Edits reach guests at once; semantic search comes back without staff action.
failureModes.actual: Text edits applied at once, but after an embedder failure nothing re-ran the refresh, so retrieval stayed keyword-only until staff acted.
failureModes.rootCause: The refresher had no retry and no start-up resume.
failureModes.resolution: Bounded retries after a failed refresh (1, 5, 15 min) and a start-up resume of an interrupted or failed refresh.
failureModes.remainingRisk: Open guest tabs keep the branch status rendered when the page loaded until reload.

failureModes.impact: A guest avoiding an allergen could be recommended a dish containing it.
failureModes.title: Allergen avoidance in other words is dropped
failureModes.trigger: 'Nothing with nuts', 'non-dairy', 'eggless', 'I'm not eating dairy', 'nut-less'.
failureModes.expected: The allergen is excluded and the allergy note shows.
failureModes.actual: Nut dishes were offered.
failureModes.rootCause: avoids() knew only 'no X' / 'without X'.
failureModes.resolution: More avoidance phrasings; a model-read avoid is kept when the guest named the allergen.

failureModes.impact: A guest's allergy silently stops filtering suggestions.
failureModes.title: A stored allergy is erased by a sentence about someone else
failureModes.trigger: 'My friend has no allergies', 'Not allergic to dairy, only nuts', 'my husband wants chicken'.
failureModes.expected: Only a first-person statement lifts a stored allergy or diet, and only the allergen named.
failureModes.actual: The nut allergy was erased and a pistachio kulfi was offered with no allergy note.
failureModes.rootCause: Lift readers ignored who the sentence was about and lifted everything.
failureModes.resolution: First-person lifts only; 'not allergic to X' lifts X; 'allergic' is never an exclusion word.

failureModes.title: The evidence classifier takes over factual questions
failureModes.trigger: 'Which dishes have star anise?', 'spice rating of the Chettinad', 'how do you know?' after a plain suggestion.
failureModes.expected: Factual menu questions get grounded answers; only popularity questions go to the evidence path.
failureModes.actual: Answered 'we don't collect reviews'.
failureModes.rootCause: Over-broad review and challenge patterns.
failureModes.resolution: Narrowed patterns with exceptions; a challenge counts only after a popularity statement.

failureModes.title: The model's 'another'/'cheaper' narrows a fresh request
failureModes.trigger: 'Something vegan please' after mains, with the model returning relation 'another'.
failureModes.expected: A fresh request isn't narrowed by a relation the guest didn't state.
failureModes.actual: The old course was kept.
failureModes.rootCause: The model's relation was trusted.
failureModes.resolution: Relation only from the guest's words (more phrasings read); the model's is traced as inferred.

failureModes.title: Turn time isn't bounded
failureModes.trigger: A slow intent call, then the corrective retry and the chooser.
failureModes.expected: No optional model call after the turn's 18 s budget.
failureModes.actual: The corrective retry and chooser attempt 1 always ran: up to 3 x 15 s.
failureModes.rootCause: Only chooser attempt 2 checked the budget.
failureModes.resolution: Every optional call (corrective retry, FAQ correction, context retry, chooser and planner attempt 1) checks the budget; past it the code answers.

failureModes.title: Client-supplied plan context reaches the planner prompt
failureModes.trigger: A crafted context.plan.items entry with prompt text.
failureModes.expected: The context accepts only dish IDs.
failureModes.actual: Arbitrary strings were accepted.
failureModes.rootCause: The context schema allowed any string.
failureModes.resolution: plan.items and shown accept only menu IDs.

failureModes.impact: A guest could be told a dish is free of an allergen its labels list.
failureModes.title: Allergen-absence claims that contradict the labels are shown
failureModes.trigger: 'The kulfi no longer uses nuts', 'made without butter' (from a stale document).
failureModes.expected: A claim that a labelled allergen is absent is refused.
failureModes.actual: Shown as an answer.
failureModes.rootCause: Absence claims weren't checked against labels.
failureModes.resolution: claimProblems treats them as safety promises.

failureModes.title: Chat fails on every turn when the database is one migration behind; health says ok
failureModes.trigger: The app updated without npm run db:migrate.
failureModes.expected: Health 503 with the pending migrations; chat answers a clear error.
failureModes.actual: Every chat turn was a bare 500; health returned 200.
failureModes.rootCause: No schema check; the chat handler had no catch.
failureModes.resolution: /api/health lists pending migrations (503); a thrown turn answers a JSON error (503 when the schema is behind).

failureModes.title: One document that can't be embedded turns semantic search off, with misleading status
failureModes.trigger: A document whose embedding keeps failing.
failureModes.expected: Staff are told which document holds search back and whether a refresh is coming.
failureModes.actual: Status said 'until the index refresh finishes' with none pending, and named no document.
failureModes.rootCause: D-13 needs every fact's vector; the status text was generic.
failureModes.resolution: The status names the failing documents and says whether a refresh is pending.
failureModes.remainingRisk: Retrieval stays keyword-only while such a document is active (D-13). Exempting failed documents from coverage is proposed, not applied.

failureModes.title: kb:index while the server runs deletes newer vectors
failureModes.trigger: npm run kb:index during staff edits.
failureModes.expected: No vector from an edit is lost or overwritten with old text.
failureModes.actual: indexKb wrote vectors for its old snapshot and deleted the rest.
failureModes.rootCause: The script used the pre-refresher indexer.
failureModes.resolution: kb:index runs the refresher's pass, which re-reads facts in its write transaction.

failureModes.title: Limiting a dish to the only open branch stores 'all branches'
failureModes.trigger: Golf Course Road inactive; a dish limited to Hauz Khas; the branch reopens.
failureModes.expected: The dish stays Hauz Khas only.
failureModes.actual: Stored as null (every branch).
failureModes.rootCause: Compared with active branches only.
failureModes.resolution: Compared with all branches.

failureModes.title: Dish and FAQ pages show vectors 'current' from any model
failureModes.trigger: Vectors from an old embedding model.
failureModes.expected: Only the model in use counts; 'unknown' when it doesn't answer.
failureModes.actual: 'current' while retrieval was keyword-only.
failureModes.rootCause: The status query ignored the model digest.
failureModes.resolution: Filtered by the current digest.

failureModes.title: A reseed leaves removed dishes and inactive FAQs hidden
failureModes.trigger: db:seed --overwrite-staff-changes after staff removed a dish.
failureModes.expected: Seeded rows return to their seeded state.
failureModes.actual: They stayed hidden.
failureModes.rootCause: The upsert didn't set is_listed / is_active.
failureModes.resolution: The upserts restore the flags.

failureModes.title: A seed category outside the menu sections
failureModes.trigger: A seed dish in 'soups'.
failureModes.expected: Refused at seed time; edits never rewrite a category silently.
failureModes.actual: Missing from the chat menu, present in facts; a price edit rewrote it to 'mains' with no log entry.
failureModes.rootCause: The seed schema allowed any slug; edits wrote the display fallback back.
failureModes.resolution: Seed categories must be menu sections; edits keep the stored category unless changed.

failureModes.title: An hours card for a past date shows no year
failureModes.trigger: 'Open on 20 October?' asked on 22 October.
failureModes.expected: The card says which year it answers for.
failureModes.actual: 'Wed 20 Oct' (2027) with no year.
failureModes.rootCause: The label never included the year.
failureModes.resolution: A date in another year shows the year.

failureModes.title: 'A table for 9:30' is read as 9 guests
failureModes.trigger: 'Can I get a table for 9:30 tonight?', 'a table for 12 noon'.
failureModes.expected: The time is kept; the party size is asked or kept.
failureModes.actual: The large-party reply, and a known party size wiped.
failureModes.rootCause: The party pattern didn't check for a time after the number.
failureModes.resolution: A time after 'table for N' isn't a party size.

failureModes.title: Rolled-back failures reported as 'couldn't confirm', locking the card
failureModes.trigger: A failure inside the create transaction (I/O error, failing trigger).
failureModes.expected: 503 'nothing was booked, try again'.
failureModes.actual: 500 'we couldn't confirm whether your booking was saved'; the card locked.
failureModes.rootCause: Every error was treated as possibly committed.
failureModes.resolution: Errors thrown inside the transaction are known rolled back: 503 UNAVAILABLE.

failureModes.title: The INV-01 oracle compared only the party size
failureModes.trigger: A confirmation card with a wrong branch, date, time or name.
failureModes.expected: INV-01 catches any detail that differs from the saved row.
failureModes.actual: Not caught.
failureModes.rootCause: The oracle compared ref, status and party only.
failureModes.resolution: Evals and E2E compare branch, date, time, party and name with the row.

failureModes.title: A staff cancel and its change-log entry were separate transactions
failureModes.trigger: The change-log write fails after the cancel committed.
failureModes.expected: Both commit or neither; staff never told 'nothing changed' when it did.
failureModes.actual: Cancelled, 500, no log entry ever; the dialog said 'Nothing changed'.
failureModes.rootCause: The log was written after the cancel, in its own transaction.
failureModes.resolution: The log is written inside the cancel transaction; an unknown outcome reloads the list and says so.

failureModes.title: Names with zero-width joiners are refused
failureModes.trigger: A Malayalam or Marathi name with ZWJ/ZWNJ.
failureModes.expected: Accepted.
failureModes.actual: 'Please use letters, spaces and punctuation only'.
failureModes.rootCause: All format characters were refused.
failureModes.resolution: ZWJ and ZWNJ are allowed; bidi overrides are still refused.

failureModes.title: '+91' typed after the field's '+91' prefix is refused
failureModes.expected: The same mobile.
failureModes.actual: 'Please enter a valid Indian mobile number'.
failureModes.rootCause: Parsed as one number.
failureModes.resolution: A doubled country code is normalised.

failureModes.title: A time in a service the branch never opens that day gets the wrong reason
failureModes.trigger: Lunch at Golf Course Road on a Monday.
failureModes.expected: 'No open lunch times on Mon 19 Oct'.
failureModes.actual: '1:00 PM isn't available'.
failureModes.rootCause: Only exception-closed services were explained.
failureModes.resolution: A service missing from the weekly hours that day is named.

failureModes.impact: Staff could ship believing every eval passed.
failureModes.title: The eval banner says 'every case passed' for runs with failures
failureModes.trigger: A live run whose gates were met with failing cases (exit 0).
failureModes.expected: '271 of 282 cases passed'.
failureModes.actual: 'Finished: every case passed'.
failureModes.rootCause: Derived from the exit code.
failureModes.resolution: Derived from the case counts.

failureModes.title: Unfinished runs compared as complete
failureModes.trigger: Viewing a running or interrupted full run.
failureModes.expected: Case-level changes only, with a note.
failureModes.actual: Area, metric and pass-rate deltas from partial data.
failureModes.rootCause: The comparison ignored run status.
failureModes.resolution: An unfinished run counts as a different case set; a note says so; no pass-rate delta.

failureModes.title: The deduper expired a running turn after 120 s
failureModes.trigger: Try again more than 120 s after a slow turn started.
failureModes.expected: The retry joins the running turn.
failureModes.actual: A second model turn started.
failureModes.rootCause: The TTL counted from the start, for pending entries too.
failureModes.resolution: Pending entries are never expired or evicted.

failureModes.title: Overlapping warm-up rounds
failureModes.trigger: Start-up, interval and staff-edit warm-ups at once.
failureModes.expected: One round at a time.
failureModes.actual: Rounds interleaved; a guest waited behind steps from each.
failureModes.rootCause: No single-flight guard.
failureModes.resolution: Single-flight with one follow-up round.

failureModes.title: The eval dashboard shows the previous run's numbers under a new run
failureModes.trigger: A finished run is shown while its detail loads (or fails to).
failureModes.expected: Only the selected run's numbers.
failureModes.actual: The previous run's numbers stayed.
failureModes.rootCause: Detail wasn't keyed to the selected run.
failureModes.resolution: Detail is shown only when it is the selected run's.
failureModes.baselineEvidence: The E2E spec failed against the dashboard before the fix (git show 0882bae:components/admin/evals/EvalsDashboard.tsx, rebuilt; 2026-10-22), and passes with the fix.

failureModes.impact: Any staff upload could stall all guest chat and bookings.
failureModes.title: A markdown document with many blank lines freezes the server
failureModes.trigger: A .md upload or article with thousands of blank lines.
failureModes.expected: Tidied in milliseconds.
failureModes.actual: 11.7 s event-loop stall for 4,000 blank lines (cubic regex); every guest waited.
failureModes.rootCause: Overlapping \s* in a multiline regex.
failureModes.resolution: Line-local patterns ([ \t]).

failureModes.title: Cancel then Start ran two eval processes
failureModes.trigger: Cancel a run, Start another before the first exits.
failureModes.expected: One runner at a time; the second can be cancelled.
failureModes.actual: Two runners; the second couldn't be cancelled.
failureModes.rootCause: The state said cancelled before exit; close cleared any child.
failureModes.resolution: 'stopping' until exit; Start refused meanwhile; close clears only its own child.

failureModes.title: Booking rate limits charged before validation and replay
failureModes.trigger: Five invalid requests with a guest's mobile; a retry of a saved booking.
failureModes.expected: Invalid requests don't use a guest's budget; a saved key's replay is always answered.
failureModes.actual: 429 for the guest; the saved booking's replay was limited.
failureModes.rootCause: Limits were charged first.
failureModes.resolution: Only well-formed requests are charged; replays of saved keys aren't.

failureModes.title: Guest contact details in a knowledge document raise no warning
failureModes.trigger: A staff note with a guest's mobile and email.
failureModes.expected: Staff are warned before guests can be shown them.
failureModes.actual: No warning; the chatbot could repeat them.
failureModes.rootCause: Warnings covered only times and booking words.
failureModes.resolution: A warning for any phone that isn't a branch's, and any email.
failureModes.remainingRisk: A warning, not a block: staff can still save it.

failureModes.title: A live eval run from the dashboard shares the model with guests
failureModes.trigger: Starting a live run while guests chat.
failureModes.expected: Staff know the trade-off.
failureModes.actual: Guest replies slow or time out; the run's latency is skewed.
failureModes.rootCause: One Ollama, gates per process.
failureModes.resolution: The live option says so plainly. Not blocked (D-21 lets staff start live runs).
failureModes.remainingRisk: Live runs during service slow guests.

failureModes.title: The dev request log prints guest names from staff searches
failureModes.trigger: A staff booking search by name with npm run dev.
failureModes.expected: No guest names in logs.
failureModes.actual: The URL with ?q=<name> was logged.
failureModes.rootCause: Next's request log with defaults.
failureModes.resolution: Staff booking search requests aren't logged.
